description: A paired NW–SE oriented convex ridge and adjacent trough system, ~350 m long, 4–5 m wide, with positive curvature ridge flanked by shallow linear depressions. Visible as faint linear shadows in hillshade, lower NIR reflectance over the ridge, slight canopy tone shift in visual imagery.

A curvilinear concave depression ~250 m long, 3–4 m wide, following a sinuous path parallel to the modern Rio Tortuga meander. Exhibits negative curvature, brighter NIR signal indicating moisture retention, subtle visual tone differences under canopy.
